ask: Lane after #552 merges, first in line: move decision-watch from classic.Stop to turn.complete. Skip turns with e.agentId set (subagent turns), as session-board does. Build the python input from the session id the mod already keeps from session.start, and find the transcript the way /dw already does, since turn.complete carries no transcript path. Keep one judge at a time and never block the turn. Drop the stop_hook_active skip, which only Stop has. Tests: a main-turn turn.complete starts a judge; one with agentId does not; a classic.Stop no longer does. Bump the mod's version. Live proof on Windows: a STOP seen line (or its renamed TURN seen line) lands in shadow.log after one real turn. Rewrite decision decision-watch-mod-limits in place and close debt dw-stop-row-unproven with the sec-default finding. No Stop hook row comes back.
note: Mac live check passed Oct 27 11:35 CDT (local liaison). Done: #559 (the decision watch judges at turn end), merged Oct 22. Cause found Oct 21: sec-default, the app's own mod, sends every classic.* event past user-tier mods, so decision-watch, which listened only on classic.Stop, never ran on Windows; #559 moved it to turn.complete, which desktop-statusline and session-board already use. Found Oct 26 (checked at 149f4bc): on a Mac every turn read 'UNKNOWN, the mod raised', because the mod needed `which -a python3 python` to exit 0, and a Mac has no `python`. So the watch has never judged a Mac turn. Fix: #580 (decision-watch finds python one name at a time, 0.0.8), merged Oct 26 in #586 (main e5525a6). It reaches the Mac through c58 (mods update themselves) or a manual `claude plugin update`. Still owed: one live check on each machine that the watch judges a turn (restart the app, take one turn, see shadow.log). Unchecked: whether the installed app package differs from the marketplace copies. Placed after c23 (triage, Oct 26): only a live Mac and Windows check is left. Mac check passed Oct 27 11:35 CDT (local liaison, main 2ca89254): decision-watch 0.0.11 installed; shadow.log holds 160 judged turns today (STOP seen, START, END exit 0), none UNKNOWN or raised. Left: the Windows live check only. Waits on: a Windows live check (waiting page item 10).
title: The decision watch runs again: the app's security mod blocks it on Stop
why: Notice you saw, Oct 21: 'decision-watch: its classic.Stop hook was skipped. cc-plugin-sec-default runs first and sent the event on past it.'
